Name: WEP_ABSORP_POS_PARAM_ST
Description: Weapon attachment points: which character dummy poly each of a weapon's models (Model 0-3) attaches to in each hold state (one-handed in either hand, two-handed, sheathed, transformed), plus the hide types and display positions used by TAE weapon-hide events.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Sheath Position Type
Fields.Description: Where the weapon is stowed. The sheathe animation changes depending on this value.

Fields.Name: Right Hand Dummy Poly: Model 0
Fields.Description: Character dummy poly that weapon model 0 attaches to while held one-handed in the right hand. -1: no attachment point.
